Only the user-approved font family, semantic type roles and navigation captions were refreshed from the shipped implementation on 2026-10-13; unrelated drift remains recorded in docs/thai-copy-typography-review-2026-10-13.md.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main form or recipe action: warm, full-width when needed, and unmistakably primary.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">สร้างสูตรอาหาร</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 180px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-button-primary, #ef5a3a); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.65 var(--font-sans, "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", Tahoma, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d94f30; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(239 90 58 / 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Circular Direction Button
components.description: A raised back or next control used in headers and stepped onboarding.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="ย้อนกลับ"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-button-primary, #ef5a3a); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-icon svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { opacity: 0.95; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(239 90 58 / 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-icon:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The standard compact form field with a capsule shape and restrained brand focus.

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: A compact cuisine, preference, or filter choice with clear selected and unselected states.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #9ca3af; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #374151; font: 400 16px/1.75 var(--font-sans, "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", Tahoma, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #ef5a3a; background: #ef5a3a; color: #fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(239 90 58 / 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation

components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; min-width: 340px; padding: 12px 24px; border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 -10px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-nav-item, .ds-nav-cook { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #9ca3af; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item { flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font: 600 12px/1.6 var(--font-sans, "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", Tahoma, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-active { color: #ef5a3a; } .ds-nav-cook { width: 56px; height: 56px; margin-top: -36px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ef5a3a; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-nav-cook svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-bottom-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(239 90 58 / 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-nutrition { display: grid; gap: 12px; width: 100%; color: #111827; font-family: var(--font-sans, "Noto Sans Thai", "Leelawadee UI", Tahoma, sans-serif); } .ds-calories { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px; background: #fff6f2; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-calories strong { color: #ef5a3a; font-size: 36px; line-height: 1; } .ds-calories span { color: #6b7280; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-macros { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; } .ds-macro { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 100px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-macro strong { font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; } .ds-macro span { color: #767676; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-carbs { background: #e4fbec; } .ds-protein { background: #eaf3ff; } .ds-fat { background: #fffad8; }

narrative.overview:
As working qualitative language, HomeMade is described as a clean, welcoming kitchen counter where the next useful action is always within reach. The world is warm, cheerful, and easy to use, expressed through a white canvas, HomeMade Orange actions, generous breathing room, friendly rounded forms, and direct Thai-first language.

The current working philosophy uses restraint to communicate trust rather than clinical styling. Nutrition, allergen, and safety information uses calmer hierarchy, explicit labels, moderate corners, and limited semantic color so factual content feels clear and dependable without turning the product into a medical dashboard. The system should not feel luxurious, premium-restaurant-like, visually crowded, or childlike.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first and task-focused within a narrow app shell.
Warm white surfaces with one energetic general-purpose accent.
Soft, confident controls and large friendly cards.
Selective light elevation for genuinely raised layers.
Restrained factual styling for nutrition, allergens, and warnings.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: HomeMade Orange is the only general-purpose accent. Nutrition pastels stay inside nutrition displays, and safety colors stay inside status or warning contexts.

rules.name: The Plain-Language Type Rule
rules.body: Use one Noto Sans Thai family with the established Thai-capable fallbacks, and create hierarchy with size, weight and line spacing; do not introduce ornamental display faces.

rules.name: The Lift What Moves Rule
rules.body: Resting content stays flat or lightly raised. Stronger shadows are reserved for the app shell, floating controls, navigation, and sheets.

dos: Do use HomeMade Orange to identify primary actions, active filters, and directional icon buttons.
Do keep important nutrition and allergen information explicit, readable, and visually calmer than promotional content.
Do reserve pastel macro colors for nutrition summaries.
Do use 8–24px spacing steps and large empty areas to keep narrow screens scannable.
Do use shadows only when an element genuinely sits above another layer.
donts: Don't style HomeMade like a premium restaurant, a clinical health product, or a children's app.
Don't introduce additional general-purpose accent colors or multicolor decoration.
Don't apply capsule shapes to cards, warnings, or dense information blocks.
Don't stretch the interface past the 430px mobile shell or convert it into a dense desktop dashboard.
Don't give factual warnings promotional styling or make them compete visually with the primary task.
